basic_info.description: Experience the best of San Francisco living in this beautiful 3 bedroom, 1 bathroom condo in the highly sought-after Castro District. The newly updated residence features a renovated kitchen and bathroom, and seamlessly blends the modern upgrades with it's classic character. The bright top floor unit is incredibly spacious with a multi-functional floor plan. Adjacent to the kitchen is an expansive storage room that includes an in-unit washer/dryer which leads to the peaceful shared backyard perfect for entertaining, gardening, and BBQing. Additional highlights include one car parking in the garage with extra storage space. Nestled in one of the city's most vibrant neighborhoods, this home offers unparalleled access to renowned dining, shopping, and nightlife. With major transit lines just steps away, commuting is effortless, making this an ideal home for those looking to experience the quintessential SF lifestyle.
